thread:
maria: Heads-up—I'm opening a docs PR to consolidate 429/timeouts/context fallback guidance. Wanted to loop people in before I push the SDK snippets.
chris: thanks! can you paste the current snippet you're planning to swap? want to make sure runtime notes match behavior.
raj: @maria fyi the SDK changed retry headers last week, snippets need to use `client.withRetries()` instead of the old decorate pattern.
jen: also heads up about the example link to /guides/context-trim — that page is moving, pls fix links in the err-ref.
maria: good catches. current draft snippet (old):
```
# python
resp = client.generate(prompt)
if resp.status_code == 429:
  sleep(1)
  resp = client.generate(prompt)
```
raj: new SDK pattern I'd recommend:
```
# python
with client.with_retries(max_attempts=3, backoff="exponential") as safe_client:
  resp = safe_client.generate(prompt)
```
chris: can you also add the runtime fallback note: "if dedicated capacity is exhausted we fall back to compatible model variants in the same region" — prod folks want that explicit.
maria: yes, adding that and a short note on prefix caching behavior for context windows.
sam: tiny nit—for the migration guide call it `context-trim` not `window-shrink` so search picks it up.
jen: i'll handle the /guides/context-trim redirect; i'll add a temporary anchor and ping infra for the link.
raj: unit test request: include a small example showing headers returned on 429 so teams can parse `Retry-After`. e.g.:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Retry-After: 3
X-Redwood-Retry-Reason: concurrency
```
maria: perfect. i'll include that and a tiny sample of parsing logic in both python and node.
chris: PR number? put it in #devops so release notes pick it up.
maria: PR is opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6123 — draft. labeling now: errref, 429, docs-sprint.
jen: I'll push the redirect patch to the guides repo and link it from that PR.
sam: can we add a tiny troubleshooting checklist at the top: "If you see 429s: 1) check quotas, 2) check dedicated capacity, 3) validate retry headers, 4) apply context trimming" — short bullets.
raj: agree. also call out that SDK `max_attempts` default changed to 2.
maria: noted. i'll add a short compatibility note and migration snippet for older SDK users.
chris: go ahead and mark for merge when ready, i'll eyeball runtime accuracy. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: PR 6123 status updated to @maria: draft -> ready_for_review
maria: merging tomorrow after fixes from @raj and @jen. thanks everyone.
